message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live air‑quality feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact AQI for Los Angeles at this moment.  

**What you can do instead**

| Option | How to use it | Typical output |
|--------|---------------|----------------|
| **AirNow API** (U.S. EPA) | `https://www.airnow.gov/api/` – you can query by city or ZIP code. | Current AQI, pollutant concentrations, health advice. |
| **AQICN (World Air Quality Index)** | `https://aqicn.org/map/los-angeles/` or API `https://api.waqi.info/feed/losangeles/`. | Real‑time AQI, trend graphs, historical data. |
| **Local news / weather apps** | Many local stations (e.g., KABC, Los Angeles Times) publish daily AQI updates. | Quick snapshot of “Good/Moderate/Unhealthy” status. |

If you’d like, I can show you a short example of how to call one of these APIs in Python, or help you set up a quick script to pull the latest value. Just let me know!
